rationale: The short thesis has weakened: BBVA bounced from the 26.00 low to 26.08, reclaimed the 5m 9-EMA at 26.05, and is now testing session VWAP, instead of making new lows. Downside follow-through failed, while price is close to the 26.15 invalidation and far from the 25.90 target. I would exit the short rather than hold into likely stop risk or flip long against the broader gap-down/risk-off context.
